text: {"lessons":["After buying all five stocks in Period 3, I made no further trades as my account fell to 84,471 by Period 10; I should review whether my holdings still fit my plan instead of letting inaction become the strategy.","I should set clear limits for how much of my savings to expose to stocks and decide in advance when to rebalance or reduce risk, rather than reacting to each month's moves.","My apartment goal is ten years away, so I should track progress against a realistic savings plan, including regular contributions, instead of judging success only by short-term account value."]}
